section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1982
title: out of 22 recorded more volume of accidental deaths per lakn of population than the all-India average of (18 ·42) and these were Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Sikkim, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. Among the Union Territories, the maximum volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population was recorded in Delhi (57 ·39) followed by A&N Islands (47 ·87) and Goa, Daman & Diu (33 ·55) while the minimum volume was recorded by Lakshasweep (7 ·50). Out of 9 U.Ts., 4 registered less volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population than the all India average and these were Lakshadweep, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram and D&N Haveli. Among the metropolitan cities the highest volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population was registered in Pune (116 ·13) followed by Bombay (63 ·34) Delhi (57 ·21), Jaipur (54.40) and Nagpur (52 ·26). The remaining Metropolitan cities registered the volume of accidental deaths less than (50 ·00), the lowest being registered in Kanpur (3 ·85) The Kanpur city registered volume less than the All-India average of (18 ·42) also. The details are presented in Table II.
